task: Two things to do on a sunny morning

evidence.title: Bondi to Coogee Coastal Walk
evidence.text: Bondi to Coogee Coastal Walk is a activity. 6km clifftop walking track past Sydney's most famous beaches. Rating: 4.8. Review: Best free thing to do in Sydney, go early to avoid heat.

evidence.title: Great Ocean Road Day Trip
evidence.text: Great Ocean Road Day Trip is a activity. Full-day coastal drive from Melbourne past the Twelve Apostles. Rating: 4.8. Review: Long day but the Twelve Apostles views are unforgettable.

evidence.title: Melbourne Street Art Laneway Tour
evidence.text: Melbourne Street Art Laneway Tour is a activity. Guided walk through Hosier Lane and nearby graffiti-covered laneways. Rating: 4.6. Review: Guide had amazing stories about the artists.

evidence.title: Taronga Zoo Sydney
evidence.text: Taronga Zoo Sydney is a activity. Harbourside zoo with ferry access and views back to the city skyline. Rating: 4.5. Review: Kids loved it, ferry ride there is half the fun. Review: A bit pricey but well maintained enclosures.
